test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 70

questions.question: The distance between two points on a map is 4 cm. The scale of the map is 1:366382. The actual distance (in km, rounded off to two decimal places) between the two points is:
Naresh invested ₹41,000 at 20% p.a. for 1 year at compound interest, compounded half-yearly. The amount he will receive at the end of the year is:
If the 6-digit number 5B013A is divisible by 11, then which of the following can give a possible relation between A and B?
A shopkeeper marks an article at ₹1,200 and allows a 20% discount. If the cost price is ₹800, find the profit percentage.

Train A running at a speed of 75 km/h takes 18 seconds to completely cross train B running at 48 km/h in the opposite direction. The length of train B is 1.5 times the length of train A. Train B crosses a bridge completely in 75 seconds. The length of the bridge (in m) is:
If the number of square centimetres of the surface area of a sphere is equal to the triple number of cubic centimetres in its volume, what is the diameter of the sphere?
A man buys 12 identical articles for a total of ₹16. If he sells each of them for ₹2.7, then his profit percentage will be ______%.
A person borrows ₹79,200 at 10% compound interest per year, compounded annually. At the end of every year, he pays ₹8,700 as part payment. How much does he still owe after two such instalments?
A car travels a distance of 120 km at a speed of 60 km/h and returns at a speed of 40 km/h. Find its average speed for the whole journey.
The average price of three items of furniture is ₹16,365. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, the price of the cheapest item (in ₹) is:
The average of 13 numbers is 28. If each number is multiplied by 9, then what will be the new average?
A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 25% above its cost price and offers a 16% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of ₹74, then what is the list price (in ₹) of the fan?

Girish scored 604 marks in an examination and was 84 marks short of 16% of the maximum marks. In the same examination, his friend scored 774 marks. What is the percentage of marks scored by his friend?
A camp has provisions for 22 pupils for 18 days. In how many days, the same provisions will finish off if the strength of the camp is increased to 66 pupils?
After decreasing 75% in the actual cost price, the reduced cost price of an article is ₹1,048. The actual cost price of the article (in ₹) is:
A total of 4420 candidates appeared in a CAT exam. If the ratio of boys to girls in the school is 15:19, then find the number of boys that appeared in the CAT exam.

A shopkeeper offers two successive discounts of 20% and 18% on an article. For the upcoming festive season, he gives an additional 18% discount. If the marked price of the article is ₹6,250, find the final price (in ₹) the customer has to pay.

A started a business with an investment of ₹21000, and after a few months, B joined him and invested ₹15000. At the end of the year, the total profit was divided between them in the ratio of 12 : 5. After how many months did B join the business?5082
The volume (in m3) of a cube, each of whose edges is 41 m, is:1951
A person borrows ₹31200 at 20% compound interest per year, compounded annually. At the end of every year, he pays ₹8400 as part payment. How much does he still owe after two such instalments?4454
